name: Camoufox
description: Official anti-detect Firefox Playwright WebSocket server built on python:3.12-slim (daijro/camoufox) with C++ fingerprint spoofing, persistent /config cache, optional WS_TOKEN authentication, slim fonts pruning, and on-demand GeoIP matching for Playwright, Node-RED, and n8n.
short_desc: Official anti-detect Firefox Playwright WebSocket server
author: daijro

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: camoufox (if left blank, falls back to camoufox).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: WS_TOKEN
form_fields.hint: Optional authentication token required for Playwright WebSocket connections and /json discovery on port 9223. Leave blank to allow unauthenticated local access.

form_fields.label: HEADLESS
form_fields.hint: Browser display mode. Virtual Display runs Camoufox inside its built-in Xvfb display; Native Headless runs without Xvfb. Default: virtual.

form_fields.label: SLIM_FONTS
form_fields.hint: Prune large (>5 MB) CJK and Apple Emoji font files inside /config/.cache after browser download to save ~1.6 GB of disk space (true or false). Leave blank to keep all fonts.

form_fields.label: GEOIP
form_fields.hint: Automatically derive geolocation, timezone, and locale from the public IP or proxy exit IP (true or false). Leave blank to keep disabled.
